title: Scaffold Android project
description: Create the Android Studio project: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Navigation Compose, Room, WorkManager dependencies wired up.
acceptanceCriteria: Project builds and runs a blank Compose screen on a device/emulator
Hilt, Room, Navigation, WorkManager dependencies compile

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Starting - package com.lodgy.app, minSdk 24, Kotlin 2.0.21 / AGP 8.6.1 / KSP, version catalog. Android SDK not yet installed on the dev machine, so this cannot be build-verified until the user finishes installing Android Studio.

Built: root settings.gradle.kts/build.gradle.kts + gradle/libs.versions.toml (version catalog), app/build.gradle.kts with Hilt/Room/Navigation-Compose/WorkManager deps wired via KSP, AndroidManifest (allowBackup=false per DESIGN.md's manual-export-only philosophy), LodgyApplication (@HiltAndroidApp), MainActivity (@AndroidEntryPoint, Compose Scaffold showing 'Lodgy'), Material3 theme (Color/Type/Theme.kt), vector-based adaptive app icon (mipmap-anydpi-v26 for API26+, flattened mipmap/ fallback for API24-25). Android Studio + SDK now installed. Found the dependency versions in the ticket were stale (Gradle 8.9 cannot run on the bundled JDK 25; AGP 9.4.0 removed the separate org.jetbrains.kotlin.android plugin in favor of built-in Kotlin support). Updated to current stable: AGP 9.4.0, Kotlin 2.4.10, KSP 2.3.11, Gradle 9.7.1, Compose BOM 2026.08.00, Hilt 2.60.1, Room 2.8.4, Navigation 2.10.0, WorkManager 2.11.2, compileSdk/targetSdk 37 (matches installed platform). Generated the real Gradle wrapper (was previously missing). `gradlew assembleDebug` now runs BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 4m44s, all 41 tasks executed including kspDebugKotlin, hiltJavaCompileDebug, dexBuilderDebug - AC #2 (Hilt/Room/Navigation/WorkManager compile) is satisfied. app-debug.apk produced. AC #1 not yet fully verified - no device/emulator connected to actually run it and see the Compose screen render. Holding in Testing until that's confirmed.

PASS - AC1 now verified on-device. User got an Android emulator ("Medium Phone", API 36, sdk_gphone16k_x86_64) running in Android Studio; installed app-debug.apk via adb and launched it. MainActivity became the foreground activity with no crash, and the Compose UI rendered correctly (first the PIN-setup screen, later the bottom-nav shell) - confirmed via adb screenshots. AC2 was already build-verified. Both AC now satisfied.
